## Requirements (re-extracted)

- R1 (Goal): every inferred/L4 value visually and structurally
  distinguishable on every surface (SIG-RECON-052, verbatim) — an
  inferred marker on every export record and every API record, an
  epistemic CSS class that styles it, and a cross-surface test proving
  no surface renders an inference as observed fact.
- R2 (Marker field): a typed inferred/L4 field on export records and
  API records — additive, back-compat; typed, never prose-only.
- R3 (Epistemic class): `epistemic.css` gains the inference-marker
  style — glyph + text channels, never colour alone (SIG-UI-005),
  outside the green band (SIG-UI-006), and distinct from the absence
  hatch (SIG-UI-007) and the Provisional chip / lifecycle Candidate
  (SIG-UI-062).
- R4 (Cross-surface test): a fixture inferred claim asserted marked in
  export bytes, the API payload and rendered page HTML; removing the
  marker fails the test (SIG-ENG-042).
- R5 (ADR-155): every touched route keeps its page-type contract — T1
  dossier rows show the marker with JS off; the print export carries it.
- R6 (stamps): SIG-RECON-052 stamped in the PR; cited ids alongside.
- R7 (scope bound): the inference machinery itself is out of scope —
  this row marks the L4 derivations `inference/` already computes.

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **Task and contradiction records carry `inferred: false`
   deliberately** — both are computed on read and already disclose
   derivation via `spine_watermark` (P25.10), but neither is an L4
   `derived_fact`; marking them true would conflate "derived work item"
   with "derived fact" — the SIG-RECON-031 distinction the marker
   exists to keep.
2. **The marker is a field pair, not a Provisional chip** —
   Provisional is the unevaluated-method label (SIG-UI-062, owner
   P36.17) and Candidate is a lifecycle state; the marker names *what
   kind of record this is*. The lexicon wording is P36.17's; this row
   lands the structural channel.
3. **Scope of "every export record"** — the marker lands at every seam
   where an L4/inferential value becomes an emitted record today
   (governance rows + links, dedup inferential entries, the
   published-record projection's every-record pair). Observed-only
   artifacts correctly carry no `inferred:true`; any future derived-fact
   path inherits the rule via `is_inferred_record`.
4. **`sig.published-record/4` → `/5`** — the marker rides the hashed
   document so an inferred and an observed record can never serialize
   identically; additive — old readers ignore the new keys.
